title: Inspect selected engineering work through command-line queries
description: Engineers and agents can discover current recorded changes, inspect explicitly selected work and assessments, and obtain exact subject identities through the published command-line interface, with understandable scope and missing-content distinctions.

includes: Read-only current-work discovery, selected status/context/show and advanced record inspection.
Complete selected explanations, deliberate projection and bounded state-aware pagination.
Explicit safe subject identity and optional content inspection.
excludes: Semantic relevance ranking, next-stage selection, approval or applicability inference.
New REM entity-query runtime support or historical-format decoding.

sources.locator: docs/design/cli/cli.md#CLI-SR-01, CLI-SR-14, CLI-SR-19, CLI-SR-21, CLI-SR-22, CLI-SR-23, CLI-SR-24
sources.basis: IR-008 Scenario Analysis identifies this durable user-visible capability across current published command use; it remains distinct from the required safety obligations and their implementation.
